title: Do You Have An Afterglow?
verse: But when Moses went in before the Lord to speak with him, he would remove the veil until he came out. Then he would come out and tell the Israelites what he had been commanded. When the Israelites would see the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone, Moses would put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with the Lord.
observation: Have you ever looked at the sun too long? When you look away and start blinking, you see an afterglow of the effects of the sun. It changes how you see everything else for a few moments. What happens when people look at you and your life? Does it change how they see everything else for a couple of moments? Does it make them hunger to be more like Christ? Does it bring them the calm peace you are experiencing in Christ? We do not live to impress people. The goal is not to appear to be something more than we are. The goal is to be so changed by Christ and be in such fellowship with Him, that the overflow of our relationship with God shines out for others to see.
application: Do you live for God in every area of your life? If not, what course corrections do you need to make?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for desiring to shine Your light through us.
